scope: Second-batch six-machine design implementation readiness; pre-adjudication snapshot.
source_note: Line references in this record describe the pre-adjudication design snapshot; preserve this record unchanged as the original blocked audit.

evidence: docs/design/teaching-skills-v1.json:64-83 allowed target push and caster advance but did not define direction priority or multi-cell tie-breaks.
sim/combat.py:_knock_cell and _free_cell_near/_step_toward already provide deterministic candidate primitives.
blockers.required_fix: Define target push direction, caster-advance path selection, occupied-cell behavior, and movement failure consumption.

evidence: docs/design/teaching-skills-v1.json:86-107 only said 50% reduction and equal-strength non-stacking.
sim/combat.py:698-705 and 803-805 integerize attack/hit-taken energy after synergy/item modifiers; partner grants use another path.
blockers.required_fix: Define one positive-energy helper, modifier order, floor/round behavior, clamp, stacking/replacement, expiry, and excluded transfers.

evidence: docs/design/teaching-skills-v1.json:145-166 said up to two allies but had no self-exclusion, stable sort, or no-eligible-target consumption/delay rule.
blockers.required_fix: Define candidate filter, deterministic order, actual-gain clamp, no-valid-target behavior, and source delay scheduling.

evidence: docs/design/teaching-skills-v1.json:169-190 did not define the multiplier insertion point in sim/combat.py:_final_damage.
Zero damage, DOT, side hits, opening combos, death, and mark consumption/expiry were not fully classified.
blockers.required_fix: Specify exact damage-chain insertion point, integer behavior, eligible packet types, zero-damage behavior, and consumption/death/expiry events.

evidence: docs/design/teaching-skills-v1.json:193-216 did not say whether activation occurs between packets or after a native chain.
sim/combat.py:_final_damage uses max(temporary DR, partner DR) followed by independent layers.
Multiple adjacent pushes had no order or occupancy snapshot rule.
blockers.required_fix: Define activation timing, DOT/sash/death behavior, DR stacking and independent expiry, push order, destination conflicts, and occupancy snapshot.

evidence: docs/design/teaching-skills-v1.json:219-241 did not define simultaneous patient selection, self exclusion, monitoring points, or insufficient-energy retry/consumption semantics.
blockers.required_fix: Define monitoring events, patient sort/tie-break, self exclusion, death recheck, healing-block outcome, and failed-precondition resource behavior.

first_batch_note: First batch remained pass_with_risk for isolated prototypes; this blocked record applies to the six second-batch machines only.
